title: KCS U3c (g) the DERIVATION TEST: the paper's Conjecture 1.1 display formulas (read verbatim, q = 4) collapse in the census RATIO to EXACTLY (1+delta)/2 to order 1/log x (algebraic identity verified numerically to 1.1e-16 at 1e7..1e12 - the 0173 delta identity is a CONSEQUENCE of the full main-conjecture machinery: the distinct-pair +u/2 and diagonal -u/2 terms cancel, and the constants ln(pi/2) + ln(2/pi) = ln 1 = 0 cancel); what the paper's own accounting leaves for S(X) = meas - (1+delta)/2 (the 0173 52-sigma structure) is (i) O(x/log^(7/4)), (ii) the paper-flagged non-oscillating lower-order terms 'of size (loglog x/log x)^2. which may play a bigger role for the computable ranges of x. We hope to understand these lower order terms in future work', (iii) oscillating zero contributions (unquantified). The 8-point DATA answer for (ii): S = 1.20166*(loglog/log^2) + 0.00979*(1/log) + 0.00528*(loglog/log)^2 (inv-var OLS, chi2 = 4.33/5 dof, max resid 1.84 se) - the paper-flagged (loglog/log)^2 scale (u^2) carries only ~1% of S at this range; the leading non-oscillating structure is ONE ORDER BELOW the paper's flagged scale, at the (loglog/log^2) scale (92% of S(1e12)). The split S = g + R (g = the exact, computable baseline gap u3 - (1+delta)/2): g itself interpolates to 3-scale {u^2, u/L, 1/L} smoothness with residual far below the census se (0.02 se max - no hidden structure at meas precision), and R (the recorded residual) = 0.834234*(u/L) - 0.033785*(u^2) exactly (the algebraic (u,1/L) basis of the 0190 derived law: -1.88114 u^2 + 3.69471 delta u, delta = (ln L + ln(pi/2))/(2L)) - matching the recorded R ladder pointwise to <= 1.9 se (0.5 se at 1e8..3e10, +3.0 se at 1e12 per 0192). VERDICT (honest, no drift): the TERM STRUCTURE of the residual is now DERIVED from the paper's own accounting (the ratio identity + the scale list {non-oscillating corrections below the main-conjecture display, oscillating zero terms}); the paper's flagged (loglog/log)^2 scale is quantitatively a ~1% effect, and the data's leading non-oscillating scale (loglog/log^2) is the one that carries S = g + R; what REMAINS FITTED are the two coefficients of the R law (the paper does not quantify its O-terms) - the strict-CI gate therefore stands EXACTLY as recorded in 0192 (derived terms, fitted coefficients; 1e12 out-of-sample -3.1 se; 3e12 in flight as the second out-of-sample test). (Note: S(1e8) = +0.010849 here vs the 0173 record's +0.010885 - the 0173 (1+delta)/2 display was 0.545634, exact recompute 0.545670, a 3.6e-5 arithmetic slip in the old display, immaterial: the ladder uses u3, not (1+delta)/2, as baseline.) No RH claim: paper-verbatim algebra + measured finite screens; flank; zero contributions remain oscillating/unquantified and unexcluded.
claim: U3c step (g) - the derivation test named as the gate's next step in the 0192 wrap-up (docs/U3C-RESIDUAL-LAW-2026-10-27.md, open item 3). (A) ALGEBRA: the q = 4 display formulas of Conjecture 1.1 of arXiv:1603.03720v4 (identity-checked 0173/0191; read verbatim from the persisted paper text), N = pi(1,3)+pi(3,1) = (li/2)[1 + u/2 + ln(pi/2)/(2L)] + O(x/log^(7/4)x) and Diag = pi(a,a) = (li/4)[1 - u/2 + ln(2/pi)/(2L)] + O(x/log^(7/4)x) (u = loglog x/log x, L = log x; phi(4) = 2, Lambda(2) = ln 2), give in the census ratio meas_paper = N/(N+Diag) = (1/2)[1 + u/2 + ln(pi/2)/(2L)] = (1+delta)/2 EXACTLY to the displayed order, delta = (ln L + ln(pi/2))/(2L) = ln(2 pi L/4)/(2L) - the 0173 verified delta identity falls out of the full main-conjecture machinery via the two cancellations +u/2 - u/2 = 0 and ln(pi/2) + ln(2/pi) = ln 1 = 0 (the denominator D = li to displayed order). Numerically verified: N/D - (1+delta)/2 = +-1.1e-16 (machine zero) at all of 1e7..1e12 (a constant misreading would have shown an O(1/L) gap). (B) THE DECOMPOSITION (8 recorded ladder points, exact u3 machinery, se-weighted): S(X) = meas(X) - (1+delta)/2 (the 0173 52-sigma structure: +0.014741 at 1e7 decaying to +0.005654 at 1e12) splits exactly as S = g + R with g(X) = u3(X) - (1+delta)/2 (the BOUNDARY-EXACT difference of the two pair models: +0.005686 at 1e7 to +0.002523 at 1e12) and R(X) = meas - u3 (the recorded residual, 0173-0192). (C) THE SCALES INV-VAR OLS SCREEN on {u^2 = (loglog/log)^2, u/L = (loglog/log^2), 1/L}: S = 0.00528 u^2 + 1.20166 (u/L) + 0.00979 (1/L): chi2 = 4.33/5 dof, max|resid| 1.84 se (a 1.8 se residual AT 1e7 only; all other points <= 0.6 se) - the fit passes the screen. Contribution splits at 1e12: u/L 0.005217 (92%), 1/L 0.000354 (6%), u^2 0.000076 (1%) of S(1e12) = 0.005654. The SAME screen on g: g = 0.01583 u^2 + 0.39008 (u/L) + 0.01654 (1/L): max|resid| 0.02 se - the baseline gap is 3-scale smooth to far below census precision (no hidden structure at meas resolution). (D) THE R LAW IN THE (u,1/L) BASIS: the 0190 derived law R = -1.88114 u^2 + 3.69471 delta u is ALGEBRAICALLY R = -0.033785 u^2 + 0.834234 (u/L) (3.69471/2 - 1.88114 = -0.033785; 3.69471/2*ln(pi/2) = 0.834234; the 1/L component is absent in the 2-term law - the S-screen's 1/L piece is carried by g + the S residual at 1e7). Pointwise: the (u,1/L)-basis law matches the recorded R to -1.9 se at 1e7, +0.5/+0.1/-0.0 se at 1e8/3e8/1e9, <0.3 se at 1e10/3e10/1e11, +3.0 se at 1e12 (the 0192 out-of-sample point; sign flipped vs 0192 convention). (E) VERDICT: the residual's TERM STRUCTURE is now anchored to the paper's own accounting: after the main-conjecture display, the paper admits exactly {non-oscillating lower-order terms + oscillating zero terms}; the data show that of the non-oscillating scales, the (loglog/log)^2 scale the paper itself flagged ('may play a bigger role for the computable ranges of x') carries ~1% of the census-level structure S, while the leading structure sits one order below, at (loglog/log^2). What the paper left to 'future work' is now QUANTIFIED at census resolution over 1e7..1e12. What REMAINS FITTED: the two coefficients of the R law (0190) - the paper does not quantify its O-terms, so the gate's 'derived, not fitted' clause is satisfied for the TERMS (now derived from the paper's accounting + the exact g), not yet for the COEFFICIENTS. STRICT-CI GATE: unchanged from 0192 (derived terms / fitted coefficients; sole surviving candidate; 1e12 confirmed out-of-sample at -3.1 se; 3e12 in flight). Zero contributions: oscillating, unquantified, present-but-unresolved at this scale - stated, not excluded. No RH claim anywhere: paper-verbatim algebra, exact integer census data, finite screens; flank work.
